findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_website · Private data: get_list · Public sink: check_website · Destructive: seo_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_website · Private data: get_list · Public sink: check_website · Destructive: seo_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_website" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Visits one website now and reports whether it loads, is broken or is out of date, with the reason. Costs 1 credit ($0.003)." → after: "Visits one website now and reports whether it loads, is broken or is out of date, with the reason, an email shown on the page, whether its domain lists a mail server, and its social media links. Costs 1 credit ($0.003)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
